scope: Eighteen author-approved dialogue substitutions across both batches. Declined proposals retained. No narration, action, scene, illustration or dialogue tag changes.

edits.before: “Bring them here. Stay clear of that roof.”
edits.after: “Blocks, please. Stay clear of that roof.”

edits.before: “You should have told us you were thinking about this.”
“That would be a poor use of this.”
“The clerk’s husband came,” he said. “She didn’t want to be alone in there.”
edits.after: “Clerk’s husband showed up,” he said. “She didn’t want to be alone.”

edits.before: “Well, I never forgave him for making me like this!”
edits.after: “I never forgave him for making me like this.”

edits.before: “You have to choose the right spot.”
“If you want to help the city, join the Defenders.”
edits.after: “Want to help the city? Join the Defenders.”

edits.before: Jenny slipped aside. “You’re powerful. You can choose what you do with it.”
edits.after: Jenny slipped aside. “You’re powerful. You can choose.”

edits.before: “I don’t know who you are, but I know I don’t like you.”
edits.after: “Don’t know who you are. Don’t like you.”

edits.before: “No,” he said. “I don’t think I will.”

verification: Reversing exactly these eighteen substitutions reproduces every chapter in the committed manuscript. Maximum three substitutions per chapter.
